processing_chain: UAVSAR L-band quad-pol data take (G-III flight line) -> JPL processor: focusing, calibration -> SLC (internal; not a CMR collection)
MLC: averaged SLC cross products (3 x 12 looks); GRD: backward projection to lat/lon onto the DEM (SOURCE_DEM)
Downstream: SMAPVEX12 normalized backscatter, SMAPVEX19-22 gamma-nought mosaics, ABoVE wetland classifications

depth_2.note: There are no PARENT or PARENT-like collections. The JPL UAVSAR SLCs (and raw data) are not distributed as CMR collections. The only UAVSAR SLC collections in CMR are campaign stacks (Delta-X, Pre-Delta-X) that are siblings, not inputs. The DEM INPUTs have their own lineage (SRTM, ASTER), outside the target's (rule 1c-1). So no depth-2 rows are written.

relationships.evidence_quote: The ground-projected file (.grd) is taken as the raw data.

relationships.rationale: Terrain-flattened gamma-nought mosaics made with ISCE Docker Tools, the cited method for UAVSAR MLC data. Generic UAVSAR file type mapped to UAVSAR_POLSAR by product type; coverage checked in Step 6c.

metadata_findings: No ATBD or processing document is linked; the JPL data-format specification is the only documentation.
No CMR collection holds the UAVSAR SLC inputs, so lineage upstream of this collection cannot be expressed.
Granules record SOURCE_DEM, but there are no MetadataAssociations to the DEM collections that exist in CMR (SRTMGL1, SRTMGL30).
Child collections at NSIDC and ORNL that document using UAVSAR PolSAR .grd/MLC files have no association to this collection (and this collection has none to them).
The format specification lists .slc files, but SLCs are not in the ASF granules sampled (.mlc, .grd, .hgt ...).
